misconceptions.description: Chasing AI-reported metrics (pace, filler count) while ignoring whether the message lands
misconceptions.trigger: learner cuts every pause to hit a words-per-minute target and the talk becomes rushed and unclear
misconceptions.feedback: Use metrics as cues, not goals. A pause that aids understanding beats a perfect pace number.

misconceptions.description: Treating the first recording as final because re-recording feels tedious
misconceptions.trigger: learner submits take one despite an AI flag of 14 filler words and a missed key point
misconceptions.feedback: Plan at least two takes: review the AI feedback, fix one specific issue, then re-record that section.

misconceptions.description: Accepting the AI coaching score as the final verdict on the delivery
misconceptions.trigger: learner trusts a high clarity score even though a human peer was confused
misconceptions.feedback: The AI score is one signal. Check it against a human listener and your own playback before trusting it.
